classification.rationale: Repository/provider uncertainty was resolved through primary-source research, implemented architecture, adversarial tests, and documentation.

rd.researchQuestion: Can ROS preserve trustworthy comparable telemetry across evolving agent runtimes without making one provider canonical?
rd.hypothesis: An execution envelope with normalized metrics, capability state, provenance, and a sanitized raw boundary can remain provider-neutral and adaptive.
rd.technicalUncertainty: Provider shapes, scopes, cumulative counters, available runtime interfaces, and future fields differ and evolve independently.
alternativesEvaluated: one canonical vendor or OTel shape
rd.result: The architecture was implemented and survived focused, integration, and adversarial tests; cross-provider semantic calibration remains open.
rd.resultingTechnicalKnowledge: Exact edge mappings plus a bounded raw layer preserve evolution; trustworthy task Git deltas require a clean baseline; session-cumulative metrics require latest-per-session aggregation.
discoveredLimitations: provider comparisons require matched live pilots
